archetype: Electric & Neon (High-End Awwwards Dark Mode) mixed with Luxury deep space

typography.hierarchy_rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings. H1 max text-5xl md:text-6xl. Labels and overlines MUST be uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] and text-xs.

spacing_and_layout.global_structure: Full-screen fixed layout (h-screen, overflow-hidden) with a collapsible or fixed left sidebar and a main chat area.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Width 280px or 320px (w-72/w-80), bg-[#05050A], border-r border_subtle. Must include New Chat button, History list, and user settings at bottom.
spacing_and_layout.header: Height 64px (h-16), sticky top-0, z-50. bg-[#0A0A10]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border_subtle. Contains the Model Selector pill.
spacing_and_layout.chat_area: flex-1 overflow-y-auto scroll-smooth. Apply generous padding (p-4 md:p-8).
spacing_and_layout.input_dock: Floating container anchored at bottom (mb-6). Max-width 800px, mx-auto. Glassmorphism panel with rounded-3xl, bg_surface_glass + backdrop-blur-2xl + 1px border_subtle.
spacing_and_layout.messages: User messages: Right-aligned, max-w-[70%], bg-[#14141E] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-5 py-3. AI messages: Left-aligned, no distinct background, but formatted cleanly with an AI avatar icon on the left.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. gap-8 between messages, p-6 or p-8 inside containers.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: MUST use backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl with a 1px inner stroke (border-white/10). Apply to header, input dock, and floating dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.shadows_and_glows: Hover states on primary buttons should emit a soft cyan glow: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)].
visual_enhancers.borders: Never use pure white/black borders. Use border-white/5 to border-white/10 for subtle separation.
visual_enhancers.empty_state_hero: Centralized welcoming text with the iridescent 3D sphere image in the background with mix-blend-screen and opacity-30 to create a cosmic, deep space feel.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-accent_cyan text-accent_cyan hover:bg-accent_cyan hover:text-[#05050A] transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-6 py-2 uppercase text-xs tracking-widest font-bold
buttons.icon: p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 text-text_secondary hover:text-white transition-colors

input_textarea.style: bg-transparent border-none text-white focus:ring-0 resize-none min-h-[44px] max-h-[200px] py-3 px-4 w-full placeholder-text_muted

model_selector.style: Glass pill dropdown in header. bg-[#14141E] border border-white/10 rounded-full px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors text-sm font-medium

markdown_rendering.instruction: Use react-markdown, remark-gfm. For code blocks, use react-syntax-highlighter with a dark theme (e.g., vscDarkPlus). Add a 'Copy Code' button to the top right of all code blocks. Code blocks should have bg-[#0A0A10] and border border-white/10 rounded-xl.

animations.micro_interactions: All hover states must transition smoothly (duration-200 or 300).
animations.message_entrance: Framer motion staggered entrance for chat messages (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
animations.typing_indicator: A small pulsing cyan dot or a glowing skeleton text effect to indicate AI is generating.
animations.input_focus: When the user focuses the textarea, the input dock border should transition to border-accent_cyan/30 and gain a subtle glow.

empty_state_background.description: A vibrant, abstract CGI iridescent sphere.
empty_state_background.usage: Use as a large, centered background image in the chat area when there are no messages, with low opacity (e.g., opacity-20) and mix-blend-screen to create a Godly, cosmic backdrop.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a SaaS AI Chatbot named 'KILASphere' with a deep space, high-end Awwwards-style dark mode aesthetic.
Implement a collapsible multi-conversation sidebar on the left.
Implement the main chat area with a sticky header containing a Model Selector dropdown (GPT 5.6 Terra, Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro).
Implement an advanced floating chat input dock at the bottom with buttons for Image Upload (paperclip/image icon), Voice Input (mic icon), and Send.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chat bubbles).
Use Framer Motion for smooth message entrances and layout transitions.
Support Markdown rendering and Code syntax highlighting for AI messages.
Ensure the empty state has a prominent, welcoming hero section using the provided sphere image as a background texture and prompt suggestions.
Ensure the design uses the specified fonts (Unbounded for headings, Manrope for body, JetBrains Mono for code). Inject the font imports in the global CSS.
For the image generation feature mockup, simply render a placeholder generated image (using a generated image layout) if the user asks for an image.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
Use sonner for toasts. They are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Never use generic purple gradients or the default ChatGPT aesthetic. Stick to the deep void and cyan/orange accents provided.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
Always explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
